criteria.reason: Role table and scope rules preserve human goal/major architecture/milestone decisions and execution requests. AI derives requirements, scopes assignments and implements/verifies within the existing authorization; proposals remain distinct from requirements.

Lifecycle and template explicitly connect milestone/requirements/success criteria/current evidence/gap/task/results. Start reassessment compares the previous dated baseline; finish/interruption updates observed results and remaining/new gaps without duplicating task status.

Eight concrete self-review cases cover unverified vs missing implementation, stale historical completion, limited request scope, changed success criteria, environment blocks, bottom-up security discoveries, missing parent criteria and small standalone requests.

Integrated context smoke passed eight positive/negative selection cases; real project generation kept four draft files and valid links without requiring a separate plan. Existing related 51 tests passed and input hashes match integration. Native repository skill validation and doctor passed.

limitations: Author self-review, not an independent model-quality or long-running goal-convergence evaluation
System skill-creator quick_validate could not run because PyYAML is absent; no packages installed. Repository minimal-format skill validation and doctor passed.
Guidance/templates/reading selection applied; semantic gap reassessment and plan updates are performed by the agent, not an autonomous scheduler
Product UI unchanged; browser E2E not applicable. Broader unchanged suites were not repeated for a documentation/configuration-only design change.

verification.scope: Top-down goal-to-work design, evidence-based gap reassessment, authorization/state boundaries, reusable templates and selective reading integration.

areas.name: contracts
areas.reason: Human decisions and requests vs AI derivation/assignment/implementation/verification are explicit. Existing task/evidence/depends_on and hook semantics remain intact; no new JSON fields or runtime authority.

areas.name: quality_scenarios
areas.reason: Eight self-reviewed lifecycle cases distinguish unavailable knowledge from missing behavior, changed goals, historical completion, small requests and bottom-up discoveries. Evidence rather than task counts determines goal progress.

areas.name: alternatives
areas.reason: Extend existing plan-project and conditionally split a plan from brief. Rejected mandatory charter/architecture/milestone documents per small request, duplicated task statuses, a new skill and a runtime hook-based planner.

areas.name: verification_plan
areas.reason: Actual integrated context selection and project generation plus doctor/skill checks, 51 related existing tests and hash-safe integration; limitations separate static/self-review from independent agent effectiveness.

rounds.reason: Rechecked requirements, generated-template links, request/authority boundaries, state ownership, positive/negative discovery and integrated current source. No remaining scope defects found.
